items.html:
Gamage was surprise replacement for Chaminda Vaas during the 2003 Sharjah
Cup, leapfrogging other, better-known pace bowlers. However, the tall
right-arm fast bowler, who bowls with a high action and good pace, has been
a consistent performer in the domestic scene since making his first-class
debut seven years ago, first playing for the Sinhalese Sports Club and now
Bloomfield Sports and Athletic Club. Predominantly moves the ball off the
seam.
